The patch has been submitted.
The bug was that `_extract_form_body` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` used the metadata of the first field to decide whether to read `UploadFile` objects as `bytes`. This caused a 422 error if a `Form` field preceded a `File` field expecting `bytes`. I fixed this by using the metadata of each field individually.

The bug was located in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` within the `_extract_form_body` function. The function was incorrectly using the metadata of the first field in the request (`first_field_info`) to determine whether to call `.read()` on `UploadFile` objects for all subsequent fields. This meant that if the first parameter was a `Form` field, any subsequent `File` parameters expecting `bytes` would not be read and would instead be passed as `UploadFile` objects, leading to a 422 validation error. I fixed this by modifying the loop to use `field.field_info` for each field, ensuring that each parameter is handled according to its own definition.
